customManagers.description: k3s release pins (INFRA-179): both Plans and the Ansible bootstrap version move together.

packageRules.description: Workspace cloudflare-tokens plans every PR with the bootstrap token, which can mint any Cloudflare token (INFRA-133): no provider bump branch, and so no plan, until the owner ticks it on the dashboard.
Database majors are one-way data-dir upgrades: never proposed. Upgrade by hand after a fresh dump (clusters/hetzner/data/RESTORE.md).

App images (contract section 8): production references are `:vX.Y.Z@sha256:<digest>`. Track release tags, ignore sha- tags, pin the digest (CI verifies its attestation). Merging the bump PR is still the deploy.

Staging follows releases (INFRA-36): bumps of manifests under a ziftbook-staging/ directory, majors included, merge without a PR once CI passes on the branch. Own branch prefix so a staging bump never shares a branch (and its automerge) with a production bump, which stays a PR. One group, so backend, frontend and migrations move together (a Renovate run while promote is retagging can still propose a partial set; the next run completes it).

Ziftbook production (INFRA-82): backend, worker, migrations and frontend move together in one PR, so a merge never runs a schema/code skew. No automerge: the PR is the deploy gate. Own branch prefix so it never shares a branch (and its automerge) with the staging bump.

TBD staging follows releases (INFRA-91), same as ziftbook-staging above: one grouped branch of backend, migrations, frontend and mcp, automerged by branch, own prefix so it never shares a branch with the tbd-prod PR.
TBD production (INFRA-43): backend, scheduler, migrations and frontend move together in one PR, so a merge never runs a schema/code skew. No automerge: the PR is the deploy gate.

Ziftbook v0.26.0 backend crashes at start (ModuleNotFoundError: mypy_boto3_s3, release smoke run 39116096441): never propose it. v0.26.1 is the fix; drop this rule once both environments run a later release.

k3s (INFRA-179): one grouped PR per release. separateMinorPatch, because v1.37.1 exists: without it Renovate offers only the minor and a v1.36.x patch never gets a branch. Minors need a dashboard tick (bump the k3s-ansible pin and the kubectl image patch in system-upgrade/kustomization.yaml with them).
The Plans leave rancher/k3s-upgrade untagged on purpose (the controller appends the version): a tag or digest pin would break that.

k3s-ansible is pinned to the commit of tag 1.2.2 on purpose (ansible/requirements.yml); Renovate cannot look a commit up as a tag and warns on every run. Bump it by hand with the k3s upgrade (INFRA-179).
